summary: Brand Engagement Network Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the cash exercise of previously issued private warrants. The company issued 15,138 common shares to BEN Capital Fund I, LLC, receiving aggregate proceeds of $259,125.60. Most shares were issued at $17.10 per share (15,126 shares) and 12 shares at $39.25 per share. After this transaction, no exercised warrants remain outstanding. The shares are restricted under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. This is a routine warrant exercise disclosure, not a special-situation event; no strategic, M&A, or restructuring implications exist.
